Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: After identifying conflicting burial information (Glendale vs. Hollywood Hills), the Planner failed to instruct resolution through authoritative verification (e.g., opening and reading the specific Wikipedia and Find a Grave pages, checking obituaries). Instead, they repeatedly sent WebSurfer back to perform the same broad searches, creating a redundancy loop and not prioritizing higher-quality, confirmatory actions. This over-confirmation/looping behavior impeded resolving the discrepancy and would lead to an incorrect or unresolved final answer.
